method: Manual original-only endpoint and local distal shaft annotation before any detector results, current analysis code, or new primary labels were read in this stage. Viewed three portrait previews and six native integer crops. Two regions of 10460940 were additionally viewed with nearest-neighbour enlargement in memory; no sharpening or new image detail was introduced.
exposureDisclosure: Earlier project datasets, algorithms and diagnostic results are known to this annotator. These three new photographs had not been seen before this annotation pass. This is an independent source-only measurement, not human-certified or statistically calibrated ground truth.
coordinateConvention: tipNative and shaftPointsNative use x-right/y-down pixels in the exact 1x crop PNG. sourceRectNative supplies the full-photo origin. Shaft points are ordered from distal toward proximal and stop before the broad merged lid line. Outward angle intervals use atan2(dy,dx) in degrees, toward the tip. They describe the visible local shaft axis, not the instantaneous mathematical derivative at a terminal pixel.
uncertaintyConvention: Position uncertainty is an engineering radius in native source pixels. It accounts for fading endpoints, coated width and manual center selection; it is not a confidence interval. Sparse selected labels do not measure whole-eye precision or recall. Biological roots are not annotated.
classificationLimits: Visible dark distal structures can be coated or bundled. Photographs cannot establish bare biological lashes, absence of extensions, or makeup history. 10460940 has substantial eyeliner, glitter and patterned contact lenses; these labels must not be used to certify bare natural-lash quality.
